items.summaryEn: Our goalkeeper reflects on a night of missed chances against German leaders
bodyEn: Kepa Arrizabalaga came in for his first Champions League appearance of the season to face Borussia Dortmund on Tuesday night, and played his part in a 1-1 draw that extends our unbeaten run in Europe.
But the goalkeeper said there were a few regrets in the dressing room after the game, as we didn’t make the most of our chances on the night.

“We are a bit disappointed with the result,” the Spaniard said. “I think it's a game that we should win, we created enough chances. I think we played very well against a very strong side. Sometimes football is like this, but if we keep playing like this, if we keep creating chances like this, I think we are in a good way.

“We wanted the win, we were playing in front of our fans. Until the end, we pushed, the atmosphere was brilliant, I think we were very close. And when you don’t get that late goal, you are a bit frustrated, but I think we have to take the positives. I think we played very well, they are first in the Bundesliga. They are a really good team and I think we played them in a good way.”

Kepa was given his chance to feature after David Raya was ruled out through the shoulder injury he sustained at the weekend away to Newcastle. “At least today I had a warm-up to go out!” he smiled. “But yeah, happy to be out there, happy to help the team. It's what we train for, it's what we are there for. When we have the opportunity to step in, we try to give our best.”
The point keeps us in the top eight of the Champions League league phase after five games, with 11 points, and Real Madrid up next early next month.

“It's going to be until the end,” Kepa said about the league phase. “It's the Champions League, it's nothing easy. Every game is a tough game; we are feeling that every game. We have to keep focused, go step by step; I think we have a big, important game at the weekend. So, let's go day by day.”

items.titleZh: 凯帕谈“令人沮丧”的欧冠平局
items.summaryZh: 门将凯帕回顾了对阵多特蒙德时错失良机的比赛。
bodyZh: 凯帕·阿里萨巴拉加在周二晚对阵多特蒙德的比赛中迎来了本赛季的首次欧冠出场，并随队以1比1战平对手，延续了我们在欧洲赛场的不败战绩。
但这位门将表示，赛后更衣室里有一些遗憾，因为我们在当晚没有充分把握住机会。
这位西班牙球员说：“我们对这个结果有点失望。我认为这是一场我们应该赢下的比赛，我们创造了足够的得分机会。我认为我们在面对一支非常强大的球队时踢得很好。有时足球就是这样，但如果我们继续这样踢，如果我们继续这样创造机会，我认为我们正走在正确的道路上。”
“我们想要一场胜利，我们在主场球迷面前比赛。直到最后我们都在拼搏，气氛棒极了，我认为我们非常接近胜利。当你没能在最后时刻进球时，你会感到有些沮丧，但我认为我们必须看到积极的一面。我认为我们踢得很好，他们是德甲领头羊。他们是一支非常出色的球队，而我认为我们很好地限制了他们。”
在戴维·拉亚因上周末客场对阵纽卡斯尔时肩膀受伤而缺阵后，凯帕获得了出场机会。“至少今天我有热身机会可以上场了！”他笑着说，“不过是的，很高兴能上场，很高兴能帮助球队。这就是我们训练的目的，也是我们的职责所在。当我们有机会顶替上场时，我们会竭尽全力。”
这场平局过后，经过五轮比赛，我们以11分继续稳居欧冠联赛阶段前八名，接下来他们将于下月初对阵皇家马德里。
凯帕谈到联赛阶段时说：“竞争将会持续到最后。这是欧冠，没有什么是容易的。每场比赛都是硬仗，我们每场比赛都有这种感受。我们必须保持专注，一步一个脚印；我认为我们在周末有一场重大且重要的比赛。所以，我们要过好每一天。”

items.titleEn: Arteta: "There was a lot to be pleased with"
items.summaryEn: The manager gives his thoughts after our 1-1 draw with the German league leaders
bodyEn: For the first time since we returned to Champions League football in 2023, we dropped points in a home group or league phase match as Borussia Dortmund held us to a 1-1 draw on Tuesday night.
It turned out to be a frustrating evening at Emirates Stadium, as we racked up 30 shots – twice hitting the post – but could not find the all-important second goal.
After the game, Mikel Arteta said he was disappointed with the result, but pleased with how we had taken the game to the Bundesliga leaders, who are unbeaten in Germany this season.

“I think it was a brilliant performance against a really strong side,” the boss said. “We are very disappointed that we didn't make the difference count with the amount of work, chances and quality that we showed throughout the game. That's the feeling in the dressing room, that we have to reward ourselves much more when we have that kind of performance.

“There were a lot of situations to be really pleased with - the quality, the connections, the understanding of what we had to do in the game, the dominance that we showed. And how much we insisted that we kept going and going until the last second, the last corner that we had another chance, and that's the way to go. Sometimes in football this can happen, but if we continue to do that, I think it will be a big difference between the teams.”
The time we did find the net, though, was via a stunning effort from Viktor Gyokeres, who smashed home a screamer for his third of the season.

“Unbelievable [goal],” Mikel said. “He's got the technique and the quality to do that. Not only that, I think his overall performance was very, very positive. He was, again, really connected to the team. We used him a lot with the ball, running in behind, connecting, short, bouncing balls. He was a real presence today. I'm really happy with that.”

The manager finished by looking ahead to the weekend, and a huge Premier League showdown with Manchester City back at Emirates Stadium on Sunday. He said he was expecting a renewed focus and energy for the game.

“100 per cent. Tomorrow we will train, then we'll have a day to rest and two days to prepare for a big match. We know the history with these matches and I'm sure what we're going to face at the Emirates.”

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔：有很多让人满意的地方
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳主场1-1战平多特蒙德，阿尔特塔赛后谈了对比赛的看法。
bodyZh: 自从2023年重返欧冠赛场以来，我们在主场的小组赛或联赛阶段比赛中首次丢分，周二晚上多特蒙德以1-1逼平了我们。
在酋长球场这是一个令人沮丧的夜晚，我们轰出了30脚射门——两次击中门框——但未能攻入至关重要的第二球。
赛后，米克尔·阿尔特塔表示他对结果感到失望，但对球队能够压制本赛季在德国保持不败的德甲领头羊感到满意。
“我认为这是一场对阵强敌的精彩表现，”主教练表示，“我们非常失望，因为我们全场展现出的努力、创造的机会和水平没能转化为进球优势。更衣室里的感觉就是，当我们有这种表现时，我们必须得到更多回报。”
“有很多情况真的让人满意——质量、连线、对比赛中必须做的事情的理解、我们展现出的统治力。以及我们不断坚持、战斗到最后一秒、最后一个角球还有机会的拼劲，这才是正确的道路。有时在足球比赛中这会发生，但如果我们继续这样做，我认为这将在球队之间产生巨大差异。”
不过，我们取得进球的方式是通过维克托·约克雷斯的惊艳发挥，他轰入了一记精彩的世界波，这也是他本赛季的第三个进球。
“不可思议的进球，”米克尔说，“他具备这样的技术和能力。不仅如此，我认为他的整体表现非常非常积极。他再次与球队紧密联系在一起。我们在控球时经常利用他，前插跑动、串联、短传、做球。他今天展现了强大的存在感。我对此非常高兴。”
主教练最后展望了周末的比赛，周日将在酋长球场迎来与曼城的英超焦点大战。他表示，球队将以全新的注意力和能量迎接这场比赛。
“100%。明天我们将进行训练，然后休息一天，再用两天时间为这场大战做准备。我们知道这些比赛的历史，我确信我们在酋长球场将面对怎样的挑战。”

items.titleEn: Every word from Arteta’s post-Dortmund presser
items.summaryEn: The manager on the draw, the performance, positives and more
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta said there were plenty of positives to take from our 1-1 draw with Borussia Dortmund on Tuesday night, despite being disappointed with the dropped points.
We went ahead in a dominant first half thanks to a screamer from Viktor Gyokeres, but were pegged back in the second half by the German league leaders.
Afterwards, in the manager’s post-match press conference, he was asked about the performance, our finishing, David Raya’s injury, Viktor Gyokeres and more.
Here’s a full transcript…
On the performance…

I think a brilliant performance. The way we played, bearing in mind the opposition that we played today, to do what we've done out there is just something to be very, very pleased about, because there is very little more that we can demand from the team. But obviously the feeling is that we should reward ourselves much more when you put that kind of performance, the amount of chances, the situation, and even shots that are not there. We are three against two, two against one, and the ball doesn't land with the right person. There is an element of luck, there is an element of us finishing the actions better. We need to insist, because I think what the team has done and shown today is the right direction.
On the positives….

Well, I think I love the way the team played. There's no question how superior, how dominant, how much of a threat we were, how connected everybody was to the game, and the relationships. It was great to watch. It was unbelievable that sometimes the ball hasn't ended up in the back of the net. That's my feeling.
On the finishing…

Mentality, I don't know. I said there is an element of luck, yes, because we haven't held some of the goals, they haven't gone inside. I don't know. Last year we hit somebody and it was an own goal. Quality sometimes, or rush, or to have a bit more composure, or to read them a bit better, the execution can be better, but everything that is in between that, I think it was really, really good.
On shooting from long range…

It depends. I think there were a lot of actions that we finished or we didn't finish, so that's a variation. In relation to the opponent, the situation you have, you need to make the decision, but certainly we could have finished the actions better today.
On David Raya…
No, we have nothing to add to that unfortunately.
On whether he can play on Sunday…
We need to know first how bad it is and whether he has a chance or not in the next few weeks.
On Viktor Gyokeres….
I think he had a brilliant performance today. I think he scored an unbelievable goal.

He had the technique and the quality to do that. What I love the most is how connected he was to the team. We used him many times in different ways. His link-up play, the way he held the ball, the way he threw it in behind and stretched the pitch. There was a lot to like in that performance and that's the victory that we need.
On whether Kepa can play this weekend…

We're going to have him or Illan, and they are both in the same situation. I think Kepa had a really good performance today. We fully trust our keepers, and if he needs to play against City, he will play.
On similarities with the Newcastle game…

I think it was for a very short period. I think it was nothing similar to what happened to Newcastle in that set. It was a different game. I think the margins today were even bigger. They were a few days against Newcastle, two top opponents, and there's a lot to like. But obviously, we want to win every game, and today we didn't manage to make that difference in this call, unfortunately.

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔赛后新闻发布会全文
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔谈战平多特蒙德、球队表现及积极因素。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔表示，尽管对丢掉积分感到失望，但周二晚客场1-1战平多特蒙德的比赛中，球队有很多值得肯定的积极因素。
凭借维克托·哲凯赖什的一脚惊艳世界波，我们在场面占优的上半场率先取得领先，但在下半场被这支德甲领头羊扳平了比分。
赛后，在主教练的赛后新闻发布会上，他被问及了球队的表现、我们的门前终结能力、大卫·拉亚的伤情、维克托·哲凯赖什等话题。
以下是完整实录……
关于球队表现……

我认为这是一场极其出色的表现。考虑到我们今天的对手，我们在场上所做的一切真的非常、非常令人满意，因为我们对球队的要求几乎不能再多了。但显而易见的感觉是，当你拿出这种表现、创造出那么多的机会、局面，甚至是那些没能转化为射门的情况时，我们本该得到更多回报。我们有三打二、二打一的机会，但球却没有传到对的人脚下。这其中有一点运气成分，也有我们终结进攻做得不够好的成分。我们需要坚持下去，因为我认为球队今天所做和展现的一切都指明了正确的方向。
关于积极因素……
嗯，我非常喜欢球队的踢法。毫无疑问，我们在场上是多么具有统治力、多么具有威胁、每个人与比赛的联系是多么紧密，以及球员之间的呼应。看着这支球队踢球太棒了。有时候球竟然没能飞进球网，这简直难以置信。这就是我的感受。
关于门前终结……
心态方面，我不知道。我说了，这确实有一点运气成分，因为我们有些射门没有转化为进球，它们没有进网。我不知道。去年我们击中某个人就变成了乌龙球。有时是质量问题，或者是仓促，或者是需要更多一点的冷静，或者是对局势有更好的阅读，执行力可以更好，但除此之外的一切，我认为都真的非常、非常出色。
关于远射……
这取决于情况。我认为有很多进攻我们完成了或者没有完成，所以这是一种变化。根据对手的情况以及你所处的局面，你需要做出决定，但毫无疑问，我们今天本可以把进攻终结得更好。
关于大卫·拉亚……
不，不幸的是我们没有这方面的补充信息。
关于他周日能否出场……
我们首先需要了解他的伤势有多严重，以及他在未来几周内是否还有机会复出。
关于维克托·哲凯赖什……
我认为他今天的表现非常出色。我认为他打进了一粒极其精彩的进球。
他展现出了相应的技术和能力。我最喜欢的是他与球队的紧密联系。我们以各种不同的方式多次利用了他。他的串联配合、护球方式、前插拉开球场宽度的跑动。在那场表现中有很多值得称赞的地方，这就是我们需要的胜利。
关于凯帕本周末能否出场……
我们将拥有他和伊兰（Illan），他们都处于相同的情况。我认为凯帕今天的表现非常好。我们完全信任我们的门将，如果他需要在对阵曼城的比赛中出场，他就会出场。
关于与纽卡斯尔比赛的相似之处……
我认为那只是很短的一段时间。我认为这与纽卡斯尔那场发生的情况完全不同。那是另一场比赛。我认为今天的差距甚至更大。那是对阵纽卡斯尔之后的几天，面对两个顶级对手，有很多值得肯定地方。但显u然，我们想赢得每一场比赛，而不幸的是，我们今天没能在这个问题上拉开差距。

items.summaryEn: Our young Gunners staged a fantastic comeback to overturn a two-goal deficit against Dortmund
bodyEn: Our young Gunners came from 2-0 down to beat Borussia Dortmund 3-2 in the UEFA Youth League on Tuesday afternoon.
Despite being reduced to ten men midway through the first half, the visitors raced into a 2-0 lead with their first two shots of the game, before Marli Salmon pulled a goal back right on half-time.

Luis Munoz was introduced at the break as we looked to break down a travelling version of Dortmund's Yellow Wall, and that's exactly what the teenager did, scoring a fantastic equaliser before setting up Josh Ogunnaike for the late winner.
Press play on the video at the top of the article to watch highlights from a thrilling contest at Mangata Developments Stadium.

items.summaryZh: 小枪手们在落后两球的情况下上演神奇逆转，击败多特蒙德。
bodyZh: 在周二下午进行的欧洲青年联赛中，我们的小枪手在两球落后的情况下以 3-2 逆转战胜了多特蒙德。

中场休息时路易斯·穆尼奥斯替补登场，试图打破多特蒙德客场筑起的“黄黑之墙”，这位少年的确做到了这一点，他打进了一粒精彩的扳平球，随后又助攻乔什·奥古奈克打入制胜球。

items.titleEn: Arsenal 1-1 Borussia Dortmund: Champions League – as it happened
items.summaryEn: The Bundesliga leaders held the Premier League champions in an open game at the Emirates2 min: Tzolis goes racing down the left. A low cross intended for Gyökeres is sliced clear by Schlotterbeck. But Arsenal come again, Madueke crossing from the right and Tzolis skying a shot over the bar. Some good early front-foot stuff from Arsenal.Dortmund get the ball rolling. A fine atmosphere at the Emirates! Continue reading...
bodyEn: Ed Aarons was at Emirates Stadium tonight. Here’s his report. Thanks for reading this MBM.

Jobe Bellingham is asked by Amazon Prime if a draw was a fair result. “I think in the end, probably … they started really well … it would have been nice if we weathered the storm a bit longer … we grew into it … mixed it up … we scored a good goal … in the end we deserved a point … we varied it well … we retained possession a lot better … it would have been nice if [his first goal for Dortmund] was today, back in England … I want to be competing against the top players … I think this showed we can play against the top teams, as Borussia Dortmund should … we want to go as far as we can in the Champions League.”

Mikel Arteta’s turn for a chat with Amazon Prime. “The performance was superb … there is no question about that … from the start to the end … really impressive … there is a lot to like and praise … an element of luck … when you generate the amount of good play, like in Newcastle, it will come … the courage … the fluidity … the understanding between the players … [Viktor Gyökeres] was really connected with the team … always a threat … [a big win] is inevitable … that will happen … we have a big game against City on Sunday … sustain the momentum and the win will come.”

Noni Madueke talks to Amazon Prime. “The performance from us was incredible at times … it feels like two points dropped … a bit of frustration … we needed to get all the points … thank God first and foremost that I am fit and healthy … I am enjoying my football … I am just trying to help my team and be decisive … we can break down low blocks … we can also play this [open] type of game … I’m really looking forward to [Manchester City] … I’m desperate to win … we’re champions … at home … you have a duty to perform really well and give a good account of ourselves … although we haven’t won the last two games our performances have been good … we are playing some really good football … [Viktor Gyökeres] is an amazing finisher … world-class goalscoring ability … I’m really happy for him.”
The top of the Champions League table. Arsenal host the leaders Real Madrid in a fortnight, before facing Real Betis (a) and Sabah (h) in late January.

Viktor Gyökeres speaks to Amazon Prime. “We had enough chances … we should have won the game … in many different ways … we played well … we deserved three points … we have to do better … it was a good goal for sure … we are dangerous … we will score a lot of goals in games coming up … my hand was down towards my body [for the penalty shout] … I don’t think it was anything … we are very confident [about getting enough points for automatic qualification].”

First Newcastle, now Dortmund. The story of Saturday night repeated itself, with Arsenal unable to build on an early first-half lead, tonight established in spectacular style by Viktor Gyökeres. That domination led to naught, and almost inevitably Borussia Dortmund were much improved in the second half: Maximilian Beier scored one and missed a sitter; Jobe Bellingham had a goal disallowed, offside by inches; and Gyökeres was fortunate not to give away a penalty. The Bundesliga leaders were worthy of a draw at the very least; on another night they might have bagged all three points. As it is, BVB move into seventh with ten points, while Arsenal are fifth on 11.
Arsenal were the best team in the first half, Dortmund in the second, and this is about right.
90 min +4: Madueke dribbles down the right. He hits a cross-cum-shot that Kobel comes off his line to punch clear … but he flaps at thin air. Dortmund somehow clear their lines.
90 min +3: Arsenal keep Dortmund pinned back … but Dortmund keep their defensive shape.
90 min +2: Rice delivers long. Kobel punches out for a corner that’ll come in from the other side. Ødegaard takes, but his flat delivery is hacked clear.
90 min +1: The first of four additional minutes. Hincapié’s delivery from the left is dangerous enough to win a corner. Rice to swing it in.
90 min: Ryerson passes infield from the right. Karetsas is in a pocket of space in the middle, just inside the box, and has time to shoot. But he takes too long and the eventual effort is blocked.
89 min: Gadou is replaced by Mane.
87 min: That’s Gyökeres’s last contribution of the evening. He’s replaced by Merino.

86 min: Arsenal stroke it around the back. Patiently. Suddenly Gyökeres slips Konsa into the box down the right. But Konsa can’t control and then fouls Anton. The Dortmund fans continue to make all the noise.

84 min: Eze steps in from the left and plays a clever disguised pass down the inside-left channel. Rice latches onto the ball, and pings it off the base of the left-hand post. Goal kick. More frustration for Arsenal, who haven’t been the same team in this second half.
82 min: The outrageously talented Karetsas dances his way left to right across the face of the Arsenal box, George Best v Sheffield United style. But he can’t apply the finish.
81 min: A brief pause in play as Kobel took a whack upside the head while claiming in the crowded six-yard box. He’s fine to continue. The game restarts.

79 min: Another handball, this time by Sabitzer, who swats the ball away from Eze out on the Arsenal left. A free kick coming up, and it’s a bit of a surprise that Sabitzer doesn’t go into the book. Then the free kick’s sent in low by Ødegaard and cut back by Hincapié at the far post. Guirassy, facing his own goal at close range, somehow manages to deflect the ball off the right-hand post, not once but twice. Kobel eventually snaffles.

77 min: … but it’s swings and roundabouts for Gyökeres, because on Amazon Prime, the former referee Mark Clattenburg thinks he and Arsenal got away with it big-time regarding that penalty shout. Gyökeres’s arm was moving towards the ball, which was coming in from distance, and Uefa’s tolerance level for that sort of stuff is much lower. He’d have given it, and is surprised tonight’s referee didn’t.
75 min: Ødegaard wedges a cross in from the right. Gyökeres springs the offside trap, six yards out, and has to score … but sends his stooping, on-the-run header wide right. Huge miss.
73 min: Bellingham makes way for Sabitzer, formerly (if briefly) of Manchester United.
72 min: Madueke steps in from the right, past Schlotterbeck, and in aiming for the near corner, whips a low drive into the side netting.

71 min: Madueke in a little bit of space down the inside-right channel. He enters the box but takes too long to shoot, and his eventual effort is blocked by Anton’s slide tackle. Then Ødegaard curls in from the left; Gyökeres’s flicked header sails wide right.
69 min: Eze’s shot from distance is deflected wide right for a corner, from which nothing comes. This match doesn’t feel like it’s destined to end 1-1.

68 min: Svensson’s shot from the edge of the box is blocked. It pings wide right to Ryerson, whose low diagonal drive is indeed a doozy. Kepa can only parry into the road of Bellingham, who slams home from six yards. But the flag goes up, correctly, for offside. It was close, mind.
67 min: That slew of changes has disrupted the match. Everyone getting used to the new environment.
65 min: Arsenal respond with a triple change. Off go White, Tzolis and Lewis-Skelly; on come Eze, Timber and Bruno Guimarães.
64 min: Dortmund make a double change. Beier and Fábio Silva are replaced by Guirassy and the exciting prospect Karetsas.

62 min: Gyökeres barrels down the left and rolls infield for Hincapié, who cushions a pass into the road of the inrushing White, who … blazes wildly over. Meanwhile here’s Simon McMahon, who like White (just then) and Beier (48 min) has missed a sitter that’s been teed up for him: “I feel I’m missing something that could well be the funniest joke ever told involving tortoises, evolution, Groundhog Day and the MBM, but it will probably come to me tomorrow.”

60 min: Madueke battles to win possession from Anton down the right and skitters into the Dortmund box. He looks for Gyökeres with a cutback but can’t find his man. Arsenal have woken up and now we’ve got a game on.

59 min: Gyökeres spins on the penalty spot and shoots, but Gadou blocks. Hincapié tries to head the rebound home from a tight angle on the left, but Kobel parries. Better from Arsenal, who have finally turned up for their second-half shift.

57 min: So it turns out that Dortmund’s reputation as a second-half team isn’t completely unfounded. That was a strong, direct run by Gadou, and a lovely finish by Beier, who had earlier missed a sitter. Arsenal try to respond immediately, Ødegaard sending a free kick from the left into the mixer, but it’s easily cleared.

Gadou drives down the middle. He lays off to Beier on his right. Beier cuts infield, past a flailing Gabriel, and thread-passes a low drive into the bottom right, past a flat-footed Kepa! Wonderful goal. It had, kind of, been coming.

54 min: That penalty shout, then. We finally discover what it was for, and … well, Arsenal have got away with one there. The corner, dropping into a crowded box from the left, hits Gyökeres on his arm, which isn’t miles away from his body … but is stuck out nonetheless. In the Premier League, it’d never be given; in the Champions League, it usually is. But VAR wasn’t having any of it.
53 min: Arsenal get careless, and immediately give the ball away to Silva, whose low cross-cum-shot from the right is snaffled by Kepa.
52 min: … but there’s no evidence to be found, and the VAR check is over. Dortmund come again through Bellingham down the left. He shoots. Easy for Kepa.

51 min: Ryerson flings long from the left. It’s … a garden-variety throw, but comes off Rice and out for a corner. From which the ball pings around a crowded box. It’s cleared, but several Dortmund players claim loudly for a penalty. And VAR launches an investigation …
49 min: Madueke glides in from the right and aims a low curler towards the bottom left. It’s always heading wide, and Kobel had it covered.

48 min: … and now they should be celebrating an equaliser. Svensson crosses low from the left. Beier nips in ahead of Gabriel, six yards out, and attempts a pinball-flip … only to miss the ball altogether. He had to score.
47 min: A quiet start to the half … apart from the constant bedlam coming out of the Dortmund section. The Yellow Wall on tour, and en fête.

Arsenal get the second half started. No changes. Dortmund have lost 11 of their last 15 games against English teams, and eight of their last nine away matches in England. Can they turn this around and buck this sorry trend?

Half-time postbag. “At the risk of stating the eternally obvious, it’s amazing how much difference a good, solid goalkeeper makes. Kepa looks like an accident waiting to happen. I’m not sure what Dortmund are waiting for” – Dave Estherby

“Not to be pedantic, Scott, but I think that’s Unathletico Galapagos shown in your earlier photo. FC were an earlier version of the same club, before they signed too many sunshine boys, their lack of fitness threatened their survival, and they devolved into the current shower. A bit like Manchester United, in fact” – Justin Kavanagh
“Galapagos FC appear to have had one, maybe two, sent off. Were they too slow getting to the ball?” – George Ronczy
“Still enjoying the Ryerson doozies. I was waiting. I knew you could not resist. Three years now you’ve kept this up. Impressive” – John Moloney
Half-time snacks. Pie: no. Melon: yes. Bovril: no. Leaves: yes.

Arsenal have been much the better team, but could only find one first-half goal. Dortmund have a reputation for coming on strong in the second half, so the hosts, still smarting from Newcastle’s comeback at the weekend, will be hoping history doesn’t repeat itself here.

45 min: Gadou barrels down the right and enters the box along the byline. His low shot-cum-cross is palmed around the post by Kepa, albeit not in a particularly convincing style. He’s still the world’s most expensive goalkeeper, yet Arsenal and their fans will be delighted at the news of David Raya’s impending recovery. Nothing comes of the corner.

44 min: Madueke steals the ball off Schlotterbeck, as the defender faffs around. He rolls down the right for Ødegaard, who rolls infield for Gyökeres. It’s surely a goal … but Gyökeres leans back and skies the shot. The offside flag pops up as a blush-saver.

42 min: Madueke brings down a long diagonal on the right and pulls it back for Gyökeres, who larrups wildly over the bar. It was almost exactly the same position as he scored from, but lightning was not up for striking twice.

40 min: Ryerson sashays down the right and earns another Dortmund corner. Svensson hits it long. Kepa flaps around a crowded six-yard box. He doesn’t deal with the high ball, but Beier can’t force the ball goalwards and it dribbles harmlessly wide left.
38 min: Ethan Nwaneri, on loan at Dortmund from Arsenal, and on the bench tonight, receives a warm ovation as he warms up along the touchline. Family’s family.
37 min: … nothing much occurs.

36 min: Rice goes over to take the corner on the left. He gets absolute pelters from the Dortmund support. His delivery is cleared, but Tzolis dribbles down the left and cuts back for Gyökeres, who should slam home from the penalty spot, but scuffs instead. The ball pings off a yellow shirt for another corner, this time from the right, from which …
items.author: Scott Murray
items.titleZh: 阿森纳 1-1 多特蒙德：欧冠比赛实况
items.summaryZh: 德甲领头羊在酋长球场逼平英超冠军，双方各取一分。
bodyZh: 埃德·阿朗斯今晚在酋长球场为您带来报道。感谢阅读本场比赛直播。

乔布·贝林厄姆在接受亚马逊体育采访时被问及平局是否公平：“我认为最终可能是这样……他们开局非常好……如果我们能多挺过一阵就好了……我们逐渐进入状态……做出了调整……我们打进了一个好球……最终我们配得上一个积分……我们很好地做出了变化……我们更好地控制了球权……如果[他在多特蒙德的处子球]是今天在英格兰打进的就更好了……我想与顶级球员竞争……我认为这表明我们可以像多特蒙德一样与顶级球队对抗……我们希望在欧冠中走得尽可能远。”

米克尔·阿尔特塔接受了亚马逊体育的采访：“表现非常棒……毫无疑问……从头到尾……真的令人印象深刻……有很多值得喜欢和称赞的地方……有一点运气成分……当你像在纽卡斯尔时那样创造出大量好的进攻机会时，进球就会到来……勇气……流畅性……球员之间的默契……[维克托·哲凯赖什]与球队联系紧密……始终是个威胁……[一场大胜]是不可避免的……那会发生的……我们在周日有一场对阵曼城的重头戏……保持势头，胜利就会到来。”

农尼·马杜埃凯对亚马逊体育表示：“我们有时展现的表现令人难以置信……感觉像是丢了两分……有点沮丧……我们需要全取三分……首先感谢上帝让我保持健康……我很享受踢球……我只是想帮助球队并发挥决定性作用……我们可以攻破低位防守……我们也能踢这种[开放式]的比赛……我非常期待对阵[曼城]……我极其渴望赢球……我们是冠军……在主场……你有责任表现出色并为自己正名……尽管我们过去两场比赛没赢，但我们的表现很好……我们踢出了非常好的足球……[维克托·哲凯赖什]是一名出色的终结者……具备世界级的进球能力……我为他感到高兴。”
欧冠积分榜前列形势。两周后阿森纳将在主场迎战领头羊皇家马德里，随后在一月下旬客场对阵皇家贝蒂斯，主场对阵萨巴赫。
维克托·哲凯赖什对亚马逊体育表示：“我们获得了足够的机会……我们本该赢得比赛……通过许多不同的方式……我们踢得很好……我们配得上三分……我们必须做得更好……这无疑是一个好球……我们很有威胁……在接下来的比赛中我们会打进很多球……[关于手球争议]我的手是贴着身体的……我认为那没什么……我们对[获得足够积分直接晋级]充满信心。”

先是纽卡斯尔，现在是多特蒙德。周六晚上的剧情再度重演，阿森纳未能扩大上半场由维克托·哲凯赖什以精彩方式确立的早期领先优势。这种统治地位最终化为乌有，多特蒙德在下半场明显有所改善几乎是不可避免的：马克西米利安·拜尔打进一球并错失良机；乔布·贝林厄姆的一个进球因微弱越位被吹无效；哲凯赖什也很幸运没有送出点球。德甲领头羊至少配得上一个平局；在另一个夜晚，他们甚至可能带走全部三分。最终，多特蒙德以10分升至第七位，而阿森纳以11分排名第五。
阿森纳在上半场表现最好，多特蒙德则在下半场占优，这个结果大致合理。
第90+4分钟：马杜埃凯在右路带球。他起脚传射，科贝尔出击将球击出……但扑了个空。多特蒙德勉强解围。
第90+3分钟：阿森纳将多特蒙德压制在后场……但多特蒙德保持着防守阵型。
第90+2分钟：赖斯开出长传。科贝尔将球击出底线送出角球，角球将从另一侧发出。厄德高主罚，但他的平传被大脚解围。
第90+1分钟：四分钟补时的第一分钟。因卡皮耶从左路送出的传中很有威胁，赢得了一个角球。赖斯主罚。
第90分钟：莱尔森从右路内传。卡雷察斯在禁区内中路的空当处接球，有时间起脚射门。但他花费的时间太长，最后的射门被封堵。
第89分钟：加杜被马内换下。
第87分钟：这是哲凯赖什今晚的最后一次触球。他被梅里诺换下。
第86分钟：阿森纳在后场耐心倒脚。突然，哲凯赖什将球送入禁区右侧的孔萨脚下。但孔萨未能停好球，随后对安东犯规。多特蒙德球迷继续制造巨大的声量。
第85分钟：比赛在短暂暂停后重新开始。
第84分钟：埃泽从左路切入，在左肋部送出一记聪明的隐蔽传球。赖斯跟进接球，一脚劲射击中左侧立柱底端弹出。球门球。阿森纳感到更加沮丧，他们在下半场已经判若两队。
第82分钟：才华横溢的卡雷察斯在阿森纳禁区前沿从左到右纵横盘带，颇有谢菲尔德联队时期的乔治·贝斯特的风采。但他未能完成射门。
第81分钟：比赛短暂暂停，科贝尔在拥挤的小禁区内争顶时头部挨了一下。他没事，可以继续比赛。比赛重新开始。
第79分钟：又一次手球，这次是萨比策，他在阿森纳左路将球从埃泽脚下拍开。即将迎来一个任意球，萨比策没有吃到黄牌让人有点意外。随后厄德高主罚低平任意球，因卡皮耶在远门柱倒三角回敲。吉拉西面对自家球门近距离解围，竟然两次击中右侧立柱弹出。科贝尔最终将球没收。
第77分钟：……但对哲凯赖什来说这是祸福相依，因为在亚马逊体育上，前裁判马克·克拉滕伯格认为他和阿森纳在那个点球争议中逃过一劫。哲凯赖什的手臂当时正朝着飞来的球移动，欧联/欧冠对这种情况的容忍度要低得多。他会判罚点球，并对今晚的主裁判没有判罚感到惊讶。
第75分钟：厄德高在右路送出传中。哲凯赖什反越位成功，在六码处本该破门……但他俯身冲顶将球顶偏出右门柱。错失良机。
第73分钟：贝林厄姆被曾效力于曼联的萨比策换下。
第72分钟：马杜埃凯从右路切入，过掉施洛特贝克，直接起脚低射近角，皮球击中边网。
第71分钟：马杜埃凯在右肋部获得一些空间。他进入禁区但犹豫了太久才射门，最终的射门被安东倒地封堵。随后厄德高从左路传出弧线球；哲凯赖什的头球蹭射偏出右门柱。
第69分钟：埃泽的远射被挡出右侧底线获得角球，但战术角球无功而返。这场比赛看起来不会以1-1结束。
第68分钟：斯文森在禁区边缘的射门被封堵。皮球弹到右侧的莱尔森脚下，莱尔森的低平斜射质量极高。凯帕只能将球扑到贝林厄姆脚下，后者近距离补射破门。但边裁举旗示意越位，判罚正确。不过非常接近。
第67分钟：这一连串的换人打乱了比赛节奏。每个人都在适应新环境。
第65分钟：阿森纳做出三次换人应对。本·怀特、齐奥利斯和刘易斯-斯凯利离场；埃泽、廷贝尔和布鲁诺·吉马良斯登场。
第64分钟：多特蒙德进行两人调整。拜尔和法比奥·西尔瓦被吉拉西和新星卡雷察斯换下。
第62分钟：哲凯赖什从左路强行突破并横传中路给因卡皮耶，因卡皮耶顺势做球给插上的本·怀特，后者……将球狠狠踢飞。同时，西蒙·麦克马洪也像刚才的怀特和拜尔（第48分钟）一样错失了良机：“我觉得我错过了一个可能是有史以来最有趣的笑话……”
第60分钟：马杜埃凯在右路从安东脚下拼抢下球权并杀入多特蒙德禁区。他倒三角寻找哲凯赖什但未能找到队友。阿森纳醒过来了，现在比赛好看了。
第59分钟：哲凯赖什在点球点转身射门，但被加杜封堵。因卡皮耶试图在左侧小角度补射头球，但被凯帕扑出。阿森纳表现有所好转，下半场终于进入状态。
第57分钟：事实证明，多特蒙德作为下半场球队的名声并非空穴来风。加杜带球强行突破中路，随后分球给右路的拜尔。拜尔内切晃过笨拙的加布里埃尔，一脚低射从呆立的凯帕身旁钻入右下角！精彩的进球。这可以说是迟早要来的。
第54分钟：关于那个点球争议。我们终于知道是因为什么了，而且……嗯，阿森纳在那里逃过一劫。从左路落入禁区混战的角球打在了哲凯赖什的手臂上，他的手臂离身体不算太远……但确实伸出去了。在英超联赛中，这绝不会判点球；但在欧冠中，通常会判。但VAR没有介入。
第53分钟：阿森纳出现大意，立刻将球权拱手让给西尔瓦，西尔瓦从右路送出的低平传射被凯帕稳稳没收。
第52分钟：……但没有找到违规证据，VAR检查结束。多特蒙德通过左路的贝林厄姆再度发起进攻。他起脚射门。凯帕轻松将球得到。
第51分钟：莱尔森从左路大力掷出界外球。这本是个普通的掷界外球，但打在赖斯身上弹出了底线形成角球。随后皮球在拥挤的禁区内乱战。球被解围，但多特蒙德多名球员大声抗议要求判罚点球。VAR随即启动调查……
第49分钟：马杜埃凯从右路内切，起脚低弧线球射向球门左下角。球偏出了门框范围，科贝尔控制住了局面。
第48分钟：……他们本该庆祝扳平比分的。斯文森从左路送出低平传中。拜尔在六码处抢在加布里埃尔之前试图铲射……结果直接踢空了。他本必进无疑的。
第47分钟：下半场开局较为平静……除了多特蒙德球迷看台持续不断的喧闹声。黄黑之墙客场出征，节日般狂欢。
阿森纳开场开启下半场。双方均未换人。多特蒙德最近15场对阵英格兰球队的比赛输了11场，最近9个英格兰客场输了8场。他们能扭转颓势打破这一悲惨纪录吗？
半场来信。“冒着陈词滥调的风险，一个优秀、稳固的门将能带来多大改变真是令人惊叹。凯帕看起来就像是个随时会发生事故的定时炸弹。我不知道多特蒙德在等什么”——戴夫·埃斯特比
“不是我想咬文嚼字，斯科特，但我认为你之前的照片里展示的是加拉帕戈斯竞技俱乐部。FC是同一家俱乐部更早的版本，后来他们签了太多阳光少年，缺乏体能威胁到了他们的生存，最终沦落为现在的样子。其实有点像曼联”——贾斯廷·卡瓦纳
“加拉帕戈斯FC似乎有一名甚至两名球员被罚下。他们是跑向球的速度太慢了吗？”——乔治·龙齐
“依然很享受莱尔森的趣事。我一直在等。我知道你忍不住。你已经坚持三年了。令人印象深刻”——约翰·马洛尼
半场小吃。派：没有。甜瓜：有。肉汤：没有。绿叶菜：有。
阿森纳表现明显更好，但上半场只攻入一球。多特蒙德素以擅长下半场发力著称，因此主队在周末刚刚遭受纽卡斯尔逆转的痛苦后，一定希望历史不要在此重演。
第45分钟：加杜带球冲向右路，沿着底线杀入禁区。他的一脚低射传中被凯帕勉强单掌拍出底线，动作算不上特别稳健。他依然是世界上身价最高的门将，不过随着大卫·拉亚即将康复的消息，阿森纳及其球迷将会感到高兴。角球未能制造威胁。
第44分钟：趁着施洛特贝克防守失误，马杜埃凯断下皮球。他将球传给右路的厄德高，厄德高横传中路给哲凯赖什。这本必进无疑……但哲凯赖什身体后仰将球射飞。越位旗随之举起，帮他化解了尴尬。
第42分钟：马杜埃凯在右路停下长传斜传并回敲给哲凯赖什，后者大力抽射高出横梁。这个位置几乎和之前进球的位置一模一样，但幸运没有梅开二度。
第40分钟：莱尔森在右路杂耍般突破，为多特蒙德赢得又一个角球。斯文森开出长传。凯帕在拥挤的小禁区内手忙脚乱。他没能处理好高空球，但拜尔未能将球打进球门，皮球无害地滚出左侧底线。
第38分钟：目前被阿森纳租借至多特蒙德、今晚坐在替补席上的伊森·恩瓦内里在场边热身时获得了热烈的掌声。血浓于水。
第37分钟：……场上没有发生太多事情。

bodyEn: Arsenal’s sky-high standards are slipping. For the second time in four days, Mikel Arteta’s side found themselves a goal up at half-time and apparently coasting toward victory, only for their opponents to rouse themselves and earn a deserved draw. After Newcastle on Saturday, this time it was an impressive Borussia Dortmund who became only the second side to take points off Arsenal in their past 15 group stage games in this competition. It could have been worse had an offside flag not ruled out Jobe ­Bellingham’s goal after Max Beier equalised a thunderbolt from Viktor Gyökeres.

But the much-maligned Sweden striker was guilty of a glaring miss late on as Arsenal laid siege to Dortmund’s goal, racking up 30 shots by the final whistle. The German side had to hang on for a result that gave their travelling fans a night to remember, although Arteta admitted his players must be more clinical when Real Madrid and Jude Bellingham visit north London in a fortnight.

“We want to win every game and today we didn’t manage to make that difference in the scoring unfortunately,” he said. “There is an element of luck, there is an element of us finishing the actions better. It was unbelievable that sometimes the ball hasn’t ended up in the back of the net.”

While neither Max Dowman nor Ethan Nwaneri – the latter on loan at Dortmund from the Gunners – made it off the bench, the exploits of another teenager were on the Arsenal supporters’ lips on their way to the ground. A stunning solo goal from 14-year-old Luis Muñoz – an England Under-15 international who is the youngest player ever to feature in the Uefa Youth League – against Dortmund earlier in the day showed that Arsenal’s conveyor belt of talent continues to produce. Aside from Myles Lewis-Skelly – a relative veteran these days at 20 – Arteta opted for experience as he made six changes, including Kepa Arrizabalaga deputising in goal for the injured David Raya.

Dortmund have not been crowned German champions since Jürgen Klopp’s days in 2012 but lead the Bundesliga by two points from Bayern Munich. Like Arsenal, Niko Kovac’s side have relied on a solid defence and they showed real resilience in the second half after drawing level. They look a decent bet for a top-eight finish on this showing.

Arrizabalaga had started only once this season, in the Carabao Cup win over Ipswich, and the former Spain goalkeeper was largely a spectator again for the first half as Arsenal assumed total control. Christos Tzolis had two early sighters after being set up by the rejuvenated Noni Madueke but the Dortmund goalkeeper, Gregor Kobel, still seemed surprised by the power with which Gyökeres struck the ball in the 10th minute when he was fed by the England forward.

He was only introduced in the fourth minute of stoppage time against Newcastle as Arsenal chased a winner at the weekend but clearly had a point to prove as his shot arrowed into the back of the net from outside the area.

If only Gyökeres could have been so clinical when easier chances came his way and the 28-year-old’s long-term future remains in doubt given Arteta’s preference for Kai Havertz. “I think he had a brilliant performance,” said the Arsenal manager.
Kylian Mbappé scored twice as Real Madrid overturned a half-time deficit to thrash PSV Eindhoven 5-1 and move three points clear at the top of the Champions League table overnight.

José Mourinho’s side trailed to Ivan Perisic’s 32nd-minute penalty, but Federico Valverde fired them level early in the second period. Jude Bellingham scored Real’s second with a sumptuous finish from outside the box and two clinical finishes from Mbappé extended his side’s 100% start to the competition this season to five matches before Vinícius Júnior (pictured congratulating Mbappé) added their fifth goal.

Como sit third in the table for now after securing their fourth win in the competition, 1-0 at home against AEK Athens, thanks to Luis Milla’s spectacular second-half winner. Lucas Da Cunha, the Como captain, missed a first-half penalty.

RB Leipzig notched their second win of the campaign as Antonio Nusa scored twice in a 3-1 home win over Lens and Melayro Bogarde’s stoppage-time own goal clinched Bodø/Glimt a 1-0 home win against Lask.

The Feyenoord midfielder Oussama Targhalline’s early own goal was enough to clinch Porto a 1-0 win in Rotterdam and Cucho Hernández scored twice as Real Betis won 2-0 at Slovan Bratislava. Press Association

Kobel managed to get his hand to a Tzolis effort that was heading for the top corner soon after, although Madueke should really have doubled Arsenal’s lead on the rebound. You began to wonder if Arsenal’s profligacy might cost them when Arrizabalaga was finally called into action on the stroke of half-time when he unconvincingly pushed Julian Ryerson’s cross out for a corner after a rare mistake from Declan Rice.

Arteta had more cause for concern at the start of the second half when a corner struck Gyökeres on the wrist, but the Italian referee waved away their protests.

There were groans at the other end when Martin Ødegaard passed up the opportunity to shoot after more good work from Madueke. That was made to look even more costly when Dortmund equalised with their next attack. The outstanding Joane Gadou stepped out of defence brilliantly to play in Beier and he made no mistake with his left foot. Clearly fancying his chances of a shock victory, Kovac threw on Konstantinos Karetsas and Serhou Guirassy as Arteta made a triple substitution. But Jurriën Timber’s first act was to give the ball away, with Bellingham denied moments later only by the assistant’s flag after Arrizabalaga had pushed Ryerson’s shot into his path.

The Dortmund goal led a charmed life in the final 20 minutes as Arsenal piled on the pressure. Only Guirassy will know how the ball managed to strike the post twice in the space of a second as he attempted to clear from a clever Ødegaard free-kick. Rice could not believe his luck when his effort struck a post with Kobel well beaten. But Dortmund stuck to their task and Arsenal had to learn the hard way again.

items.titleZh: 多特蒙德拜尔阻挡阿森纳连胜，约克雷斯世界波难救主
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳在半场领先的情况下被多特蒙德逼平，遭遇各项赛事连续两场被对手在下半场扳平。
bodyZh: 阿森纳极高的标准正在滑落。在四天内第二次，米克尔·阿尔特塔的球队在半场结束时取得领先，并且看似正稳步走向胜利，但他们的对手却振作起来并赢得了当之无愧的平局。继周六对阵纽卡斯尔之后，这一次令人印象深刻的多特蒙德成为了阿森纳在该项赛事过去15场小组赛中仅有的第二支从他们身上拿分的球队。如果不是因为越位旗吹掉了乔布·贝林厄姆的进球，情况可能会更糟，此前马克西米利安·拜尔扳平了维克托·约克雷斯的惊天世界波。
但这位备受诟病的瑞典前锋在比赛尾声错失了一次绝佳机会，当时阿森纳对多特蒙德的球门展开了围攻，全场比赛结束时轰出了30脚射门。这家德国球队不得不苦苦支撑以守住这个让随队远征球迷难忘的结果，尽管阿尔特塔承认两周后皇家马德里和裘德·贝林厄姆访问北伦敦时，他的球员们必须表现得更加冷酷高效。
“我们希望赢得每一场比赛，而不幸的是今天我们没能在进球转化上拉开差距，”他说。“这里面有运气的成分，也有我们如何更好地完成射门终结的成分。有时候皮球没有钻进网窝，这真是不可思议。”

虽然马克斯·道曼和伊森·恩瓦内里——后者从枪手租借效力于多特蒙德——都没能获得出场机会，但另一位少年的惊艳表现成为了阿森纳球迷在前往球场路上的谈资。14岁的小将路易斯·穆尼奥斯——一名英格兰U15国脚，也是欧足联青年联赛历史上最年轻的出场球员——早些时候对阵多特蒙德时打出了一记精彩的个人进球，这表明阿森纳的人才流水线仍在源源不断地输出。除了迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利这位20岁已算“老将”的球员外，阿尔特塔选择了经验，他做出了六处人员调整，其中包括由凯帕·阿里萨巴拉加顶替受伤的大卫·拉亚把守球门。
多特蒙德自尤尔根·克洛普时代的2012年以来就未能在德国本土捧起过联赛冠军奖杯，但目前在德甲积分榜上以两分优势领先拜仁慕尼黑。与阿森纳一样，尼科·科瓦奇的球队依靠的是稳固的防守，他们在扳平比分后在下半场展现出了真正的韧性。从这场比赛的表现来看，他们很有希望锁定前八名。
阿里萨巴拉加本赛季仅首发过一次，那是在联赛杯战胜伊普斯维奇的比赛中，这位前西班牙门将由于阿森纳在上半场取得全面控制而再次大部分时间处于看客状态。克里斯托斯·齐奥利斯在受到焕发新生的诺尼·马杜埃凯助攻后有两次早期的试射，但多特蒙德门将格雷戈尔·科贝尔对约克雷斯在第10分钟接英格兰前锋传球后轰出的皮球力量似乎仍感到吃惊。
他在上周末对阵纽卡斯尔时直到补时第四分钟才替补登场，当时阿森纳正在全力追寻制胜球，但这次他的射门从禁区外直窜网窝，显然证明了自己。
要是约克雷斯在面对更容易的进球机会时也能如此冷酷就好了，考虑到阿尔特塔更偏爱凯·哈弗茨，这位28岁球员的长期未来仍然存在疑问。“我认为他有着出色的表现，”阿森纳主帅说道。
基利安·姆巴佩梅开二度，帮助皇家马德里在上半场落后的情况下逆转，以5比1大胜埃因霍温，在积分榜上暂时以三分优势领跑欧冠积分榜。
何塞·穆里尼奥的球队由于伊万·佩里西奇在第32分钟罚入点球而落后，但费代里科·巴尔韦德在下半场初段将比分扳平。裘德·贝林厄姆用一脚禁区外的精彩射门攻入皇马的第二球，随后姆巴佩两次冷静的终结将球队本赛季在该项赛事的全胜开局扩大到五场，维尼修斯·儒尼奥尔则攻入了他们的第五球。
科莫目前在积分榜上排名第三，他们在主场以1比0击败AEK雅典，取得了该项赛事的第四场胜利，路易斯·米拉在下半场打入精彩的制胜球。科莫队长卢卡斯·达库尼亚在上半场罚丢了一粒点球。
RB莱比锡取得了本赛季的第二场胜利，安东尼奥·努萨在主场3比1击败朗斯的比赛中梅开二度，而梅莱罗·博加德在补时阶段的乌龙球帮助博德闪耀在主场1比0战胜LASK林茨。
费耶诺德中场乌萨马·塔尔加林的早期乌龙球足以帮助波尔图在鹿特丹以1比0取胜，库乔·埃尔南德斯梅开二度，帮助皇家贝蒂斯在客场2比0战胜布拉提斯拉瓦。新闻协会
科贝尔不久后成功单掌托出了齐奥利斯飞向死角的射门，尽管马杜埃凯本该在补射中将阿森纳的领先优势扩大。当德克兰·赖斯出现罕见失误后，阿里萨巴拉加终于在半场结束前被迫做出扑救，勉强将朱利安·赖尔森的传中扑出底线，你开始怀疑阿森纳的挥霍是否会让他们付出代价。

在新闻简报推广之后
当角球击中约克雷斯的手腕时，阿尔特塔在下半场开始时有了更多的担忧，但意大利裁判挥手示意比赛继续。

在马丁·厄德高在马杜埃凯又一次精彩表现后放弃了射门机会时，另一端传出了叹息声。这使得随后的丢球显得更加昂贵，多特蒙德利用下一次进攻扳平了比分。表现出色的若昂·加杜勇敢地从防线中插上并传球给拜尔，后者用左脚冷静破门。科瓦奇显然看好爆冷取胜的机会，换上了康斯坦丁诺斯·卡雷察斯和塞尔胡·吉拉西，而阿尔特塔则进行了三人换人调整。但尤里延·蒂贝尔登场后的第一个动作就是将球传丢，几分钟后贝林厄姆的进球仅因边裁举旗示意越位而被吹掉，此前阿里萨巴拉加将赖尔森的射门扑到了他的脚下。
在最后的20分钟里，多特蒙德的球门吉星高照，阿森纳持续施压。吉拉西在试图解围厄德高精妙的任意球时，皮球如何在短短一秒内两次击中门柱，恐怕只有他自己知道了。赖斯简直不敢相信自己的运气，他的射门在科贝尔毫无办法的情况下击中了门柱。但多特蒙德坚守到底，阿森纳不得不再次付出沉重代价吸取教训。

items.summaryEn: The story of our Champions League draw at Emirates Stadium
bodyEn: We extended our unbeaten run in the Champions League, but were left to rue a succession of missed chances on an eventful night in north London.
We went ahead in a dominant first half thanks to a cracker from Viktor Gyokeres, who powered his shot over the keeper and into the net from outside the area.
We were made to pay for not making the most of our superiority though, when Maximilian Beier finished neatly ten minutes after the restart.
We hit the post twice in the second half, and Gyokeres headed a great chance wide, but we couldn’t find the all-important second goal.
It’s the first time we have dropped points at home in the league phase of the Champions League.
STUNNING OPENER
We started really brightly in this meeting of the Bundesliga and Premier League leaders.
After just two minutes, the lively Noni Madueke crossed for an unmarked Christos Tzolis in the area, but he volleyed the ball into the ground and over the bar.
Gyokeres tried a long-range daisy-cutter that was comfortably gathered before another Madueke cross was headed back across goal by Tzolis, but could not be converted.
We were looking especially dangerous on the right, and a wicked, whipped Ben White cross was begging to be headed in, but was just ahead of Gabriel and Piero Hincapie.
But then the goal our play in the opening ten minutes deserved arrived, and what a peach it was. Madueke again had his marker backing off him, and he rolled the ball to Gyokeres 25 yards out.

There didn’t seem to be much on for the Swede, but he pulled the trigger to send a dipping, unstoppable drive over goalkeeper Gregor Kobel and into the net. A stunner, and a fitting way to bring up our 400th goal in Champions League history.
SEARCHING FOR A SECOND

Goal number 401 should have followed five minutes later as we kept our collective foot on the gas. Tzolis worked into the box on his right foot, and saw his effort was parried away by Kobel. The rebound fell nicely to Madueke at the far post, but he couldn’t sort his feet out in time, and his shot was blocked.
There were 20 minutes on the clock before the Germans had an attempt on Kepa Arrizabalaga’s goal, but Fabio Silva’s speculative shot sailed over the bar.

We were pushing the visitors back, committing men forward, and Piero Hincapie was the next to pop up inside the area. He had a clear sight of goal, but tried the cutback to Gyokeres instead, and it was intercepted.

Declan Rice, who had made a superb tackle on England teammate Jobe Bellingham to launch a counter-attack a few moments earlier, then tried to emulate Gyokeres with a dipping long-range shot, but it skimmed over the bar.

Rice then had a much closer sight of goal after being sent through by an exquisite Martin Odegaard touch in midfield. Just as the England man pulled the trigger though, Nico Schlotterbeck stuck out a leg to deny him.

At times we were purring in attack, but the final pass or shot did not always match the quality of the build-up. Just before half-time Gyokeres shot over from a perfect Odegaard. He was flagged offside, but replays suggested it would have stopped.

The closest Dortmund came to scoring in the opening half was in injury time. They suddenly outnumbered us in attack, and Joane Gadou aimed for the near post, but Arrizabalaga turned it away for a corner.
BORUSSIA BITE BACK

We had a huge let-off straight after the break. Beier was in front of goal, no more than six yards out when a low cross from the left found its way through to him, but he completely air-kicked his effort, and we survived.
At the other end, Madueke was enjoying himself on the right and cut inside past a couple of defenders before curling his low shot just wide.
But in truth the Germans had been the better side since the restart and they levelled on 55 minutes.
Gadou burst through the middle of the park on a powerful run, releasing Beier in the area. He chopped past Gabriel and then neatly finished low inside the near post.

We had to start all over again. Hincapie forced a save from Kobel with a header from a narrow angle before Madueke shrugged off his marker, made a beeline for the penalty area, but couldn’t find a red shirt with his cutback.
White then blazed over after good work from Gyokeres on the left.
CHANCES COME AND GO
Bellingham had the ball in the net for the visitors only for the assistant’s flag to go up for offside.
Mikel Arteta sent for his replacements, including scorer at the weekend Eberechi Eze, and he nearly made an immediate impact, but his shot was deflected over for a corner.

We had stepped up the intensity again. Madueke was superbly denied by a Waldemar Anton tackle, Gyokeres headed a Martin Odegaard cross wide, and Madueke hit wide in quick succession as we racked up the goal attempts.
Gyokeres had a superb chance to restore our lead when he met Odegaard’s perfect cross with a diving header. His aim was off, however and he couldn’t trouble the keeper.
The Dortmund goal was starting to lead a charmed life, and Serhou Guirassy hit the ball against his own post as they tried to deal with a devilish low Odegaard free-kick.
Rice then hit the other upright, with the keeper beaten, after being set up by Eze.
But we couldn’t get the goal, despite having 29 shots on the night, and our 100 per cent record in the league and group stage of the Champions League came to an end.
WHAT’S NEXT

It’s back to Premier League action on Sunday, as we host Manchester City in a huge clash at Emirates Stadium. Our next Champions League game is also here at Emirates Stadium, against Real Madrid, on December 9.

items.summaryZh: 我们在欧冠主场战平多特蒙德，延续不败战绩但错失多次良机。
bodyZh: 我们在欧冠中延续了不败战绩，但在北伦敦这个精彩的夜晚，面对接连错失的良机只能感到遗憾。
凭借维克托·哲凯赖什在禁区外的一记精彩世界波越过门将飞入网窝，我们在占优的上半场率先取得领先。
然而，马克西米利安·拜尔在下半场开始十分钟后冷静破门，让我们为未能充分利用优势付出了代价。
我们在下半场两次击中门柱，哲凯赖什也有一记绝佳的头球顶偏，但我们未能找到至关重要的第二粒进球。
这是我们在欧冠联赛阶段首次在主场丢分。
精彩的闪击
在这场德甲与英超领头羊的较无人盯防的交锋中，我们开局状态极佳。
开场仅仅两分钟，活跃的农尼·马杜埃凯在禁区内传中找到无人盯防的克里斯托斯·齐奥利斯，但他将球垫射入地并高出横梁。
哲凯赖什尝试了一脚远距离低平球射门被轻松没收，随后马杜埃凯的又一次传中被齐奥利斯头球顶回门前，但未能转化成进球。
我们在右路显得格外危险，本·怀特一脚美妙且旋转极佳的传中本有望被顶入，但落点稍微超出了加布里埃尔和皮埃罗·因卡皮耶的头顶。
但随后，我们在开局十分钟内配得上的一粒进球到来了，这是一记极其精彩的进球。马杜埃凯再次利用对方防守后退的时机，将球回做给距球门25码外的哲凯赖什。
这对于这名瑞典前锋来说似乎并没有太大空间，但他果断起脚，轰出一记下坠且势不可挡的射门，越过门将格雷戈尔·科贝尔飞入网窝。这是一记惊艳的进球，也是纪念我们欧冠历史第400球的完美方式。
寻找第二球
五分钟后本应诞生第401球，我们保持着进攻的势头。齐奥利斯用右脚突入禁区，他的射门被科贝尔扑出。远端的马杜埃凯迎球补射，但他的调整不够及时，射门被封堵。
比赛进行到20分钟时，德国球队才完成了第一次射门威胁到凯帕·阿里萨拉巴加的球门，但法比奥·西尔瓦的盲目远射高出了横梁。
我们将客队压制回去，全员压上进攻，皮埃罗·因卡皮耶是下一个出现在禁区内的人。他有清晰的射门视线，但转而尝试倒三角传给哲凯赖什，结果被拦截。
德克兰·莱斯几分钟前对英格兰队友若贝·贝林厄姆做出了一次精彩的铲断并发起反击，随后他试图效仿哲凯赖什来一脚下坠远射，但皮球擦着横梁飞过。
在马丁·厄德高在中场送出精妙触球后，莱斯获得了更近距离的射门良机。然而就在这位英格兰球员准备起脚时，尼科·施洛特贝克伸出一腿化解了危机。
我们的进攻有时流畅华丽，但最后的传球或射门并未总能匹配进攻组织的质量。半场结束前，哲凯赖什接厄德高的完美传球将球射高。他被判越位在先，但回放显示原本可能会被阻止。
多特蒙德在上半场最接近进球的时刻出现在伤停补时阶段。他们突然在进攻端形成人数优势，若昂·加杜直奔近门柱，但阿里萨拉巴加将球扑出底线。
多特蒙德反扑
下半场刚开始我们就逃过一劫。当左路的一记低平球传到门前时，拜尔在距离球门不到六码处面对空门竟然踢空了，我们幸运地存活下来。
在另一端，马杜埃凯在右路踢得很开心，他内切晃过几名后卫后，低射稍稍偏出。
但客观而言，德国球队在下半场开始后表现更好，并在第55分钟扳平了比分。
加杜从中路强力突破，在禁区内分球给拜尔。拜尔晃过加布里埃尔，随后在近门柱冷静低射破门。
我们不得不一切从头再来。因卡皮耶的头球攻门迫使科贝尔做出扑救，随后马杜埃凯摆脱防守队员直奔禁区，但倒三角传球未能找到红衣队友。
在哲凯赖什在左路做出精彩表现后，怀特随后将球射高。
机会转瞬即逝
贝林厄姆曾为客队将球打进网窝，但边裁举旗示意越位。
米克尔·阿尔特塔调兵遣将，换上了包括周末的进球功臣埃贝雷奇·埃泽在内的替补球员，他险些立刻产生影响，但他的射门被挡出底线。
我们再次提升了强度。马杜埃凯的射门被瓦尔德马尔·安东的精彩铲断化解，哲凯赖什接厄德高传球头球偏出，马杜埃凯随后紧接着连续射门偏出，我们的射门次数急剧上升。
哲凯赖什迎着厄德高完美的传球鱼跃冲顶，迎来了恢复领先的绝佳机会。然而他的准星失准，未能对门将造成威胁。
多特蒙德的球门开始走运，当他们试图应对厄德高极具威胁的任意球低平球时，塞鲁·吉拉西将球打在了自家门柱上。
在埃泽的助攻下，莱斯在门将已经无能为力的情况下击中了另一根立柱。
尽管我们在当晚完成了29次射门，但我们没能打进这球，我们在欧冠联赛和小组赛中的全胜纪录也就此终结。
接下来的赛程
周日我们将重返英超赛场，在酋长球场迎来与曼城的一场焦点大战。我们的下一场欧冠比赛也将于12月9日在酋长球场进行，对阵皇家马德里。

items.titleEn: Team news: Gyokeres starts against Dortmund
items.summaryEn: Striker one of six changes from weekend line up
bodyEn: Viktor Gyokeres starts up front for us against Borussia Dortmund in the Champions League on Tuesday night.

The striker is one of six changes from the team that started against Newcastle United on Saturday in the Premier League. As expected Kepa Arrizabalaga comes in to replace the injured David Raya in goal, for only his second Champions League start for us.

Both full-back positions have changed, with Piero Hincapie and Ben White replacing Riccardo Calafiori and Jurrien Timber. Christos Tzolis comes back in for Eberechi Eze while Myles Lewis-Skelly is recalled in midfield.
Bukayo Saka and Martin Zubimendi are the other players who remain absent through injury, while William Saliba is once again on the bench.
Borussia Dortmund arrive in London top of the Bundesliga – still unbeaten – and just one point behind us in the Champions League standings.
They beat Borussia Monchengladbach 1-0 away at the weekend, and make two changes from that team. In come Joey Veerman and Waldemar Anton for Konstantinos Karetsas and Ramy Bensebaini.
Ethan Nwaneri is on loan from us for the season in Dortmund, but is eligible for this game. He is named among the substitutes.

items.titleZh: 球队新闻：哲凯赖什对阵多特蒙德首发
items.summaryZh: 锋线杀手成为周末首发阵容的六处调整之一。
bodyZh: 周二晚上的欧冠比赛中，维克托·哲凯赖什将为我们对阵多特蒙德的比赛首发登场。
这位前锋是继周六在英超对阵纽卡斯尔联队的首发阵容之后的六处调整之一。如预期一样，凯帕·阿里萨巴拉加顶替受伤的大卫·拉亚把守大门，这也是他为我们迎来的第二场欧冠首发。
两个边后卫位置均有调整，皮耶罗·因卡皮耶和本·怀特分别顶替里卡多·卡拉菲奥里和尤里恩·廷贝尔。克里斯托斯·齐奥利斯顶替埃贝雷奇·埃泽重回首发，迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利则重回中场。
布卡约·萨卡和马丁·祖比门迪是另外两名因伤缺阵的球员，而威廉·萨利巴再次坐在替补席上。
多特蒙德抵达伦敦时位居德甲榜首——至今保持不败——在欧冠积分榜上也仅落后我们一分。
他们在周末的客场比赛中以 1-0 击败门兴格拉德巴赫，并对那套阵容做出两处调整。乔伊·费尔曼和瓦尔德马尔·安东顶替康斯坦丁诺斯·卡雷察斯和拉米·本塞拜尼。
伊森·恩瓦内里本赛季被租借至多特蒙德，但他有资格参加本场比赛。他被列入替补名单。

items.titleEn: Horseman praises U19s character in comeback win
items.summaryEn: Our Academy Head Coach felt we recovered well after a difficult start
bodyEn: David Horseman felt our under-19s recovered well from a difficult start against Borussia Dortmund to come back and secure a 3-2 win.
The Black and Yellow were reduced to ten men when goalkeeper Aaron Held was sent off, but took a 2-0 lead shortly after.
We fought back to take the points though thanks to goals from Marli Salmon, Luis Munoz and Josh Ogunnaike, leaving us with a great chance to qualify for the UEFA Youth League knockout stages.
"It was another brilliant experience for the young players," Horseman said on the contest, "we played a very good team, did a lot of research, obviously they're doing well in the competition.

"The game started really quick, really frantic, lots of transitions, lots of counter-pressing, and then, as the game settled down, and the keeper gets sent off. You think it's 60 minutes or so, eleven against ten, and you think just nice and calm, move the ball, work them, because eventually a chance will come.

"But actually, it was really interesting in young players' development, they really panicked, couldn't organise quickly and we ended up conceding a really poor goal. We've got enough bodies in the box to deal with it, don't mark, don't make the duel, 1-0 down, then obviously the second goal is a big individual mistake, but it's fine, he's 15, he's going to learn, he's very good."
Despite a largely disappointing first half, we did give ourselves a lifeline before the break thanks to Marli Salmon's header.
Horseman felt this was a key moment in the game and, along with the introduction of Luis Munoz at the break, gave us the foothold to push on and turn the game around.

"We scored a massive goal because of a great header, and we go in at half-time and I thought brining Luiz on, particularly, had a huge impact on the game. I thought what the boys showed was unbelievable character for such young players, because remember, we're much younger than even them.

"But we trust them and believe in them, and I thought they showed the character and mentality, and we deserved to win the game in the end, in the circumstances they were thrown into, but there's so much learning in this competition.

"It's why, ideally, we want to give them at least another game, or as many games as possible, because these games are so much higher level than what we play in domestically, and we play against an under-19s team that play a game with each other every week, and we come together for a couple of days before."
Victory over Dortmund has put us right in the mix for a place in the knockout stages, with the top 22 sides reaching the Round of 32.

Horseman feels that it will be tough give we host defending champions Real Madrid in our final game, but our Academy Head Coach has seen enough from our opening five games to believe we're in with a real chance of getting something from the game.

"If they want careers, whether it is or not, the media make these big games showdowns, so for us to prepare them the best we can, we have to give them a tiny taste of what they're hoping to go into every week. This is ideal.

"They're probably the best team in Europe. They won it last year, they were top of the league out of all the 30-odd teams, they're very good. This is the type of level of game that is going to be tough, but we're good too.
"We score goals, we've been in every game so far; I think we'll need a point, our goal difference is OK so it's given us a bit of a chance. We'll have a go because actually there's a bigger picture.

"But for us and the boys in there, I think with the group of games we've had, we haven't had the [easiest] of games, we've had tough games every game. The boys have been an absolute credit, so we go into the last game and we're hopeful. We'll try our best and seem what comes."

items.titleZh: 霍斯曼赞扬U19队员在逆转取胜中展现的坚韧性格
items.summaryZh: 学院主教练认为我们在经历艰难开局后恢复得很好。
bodyZh: 大卫·霍斯曼认为，我们的U19队员在对阵多特蒙德时从艰难的开局中很好地恢复过来，最终逆转以3-2取胜。
黄黑军团门将阿伦·赫尔德被罚下场，导致他们只剩十人应战，但不久后他们却取得了2-0的领先。
不过，凭借马利·萨尔门、路易斯·穆尼奥斯和乔什·奥古奈克的进球，我们奋起直追全取三分，这让我们获得了晋级欧洲青年联赛淘汰赛阶段的绝佳机会。
谈到这场比赛时，霍斯曼表示：“对年轻球员来说，这又是一次极棒的体验。我们对阵了一支非常优秀的球队，做了大量研究，显然他们在该赛事中表现很好。”
“比赛开始得非常快、非常狂热，有大量的转换和高位逼抢。后来比赛平静下来，对方门将吃红牌被罚下。你当时会想，场上是11打10，大约还有60分钟时间，只需保持冷静、传好球、调动对手，机会终究会到来。”
“但实际上，这对于年轻球员的发展来说非常有趣，他们真的惊慌失措了，没能快速组织好防守，结果我们丢了一个非常糟糕的球。禁区里有足够的人手去应对，却不去盯人、不去争抢，导致0-1落后。随后第二个丢球显然是一次严重的个人失误，但没关系，他才15岁，他会吸取教训的，他非常优秀。”
尽管上半场表现大体令人失望，但在中场休息前，我们凭借马利·萨尔门的头球为自己留住了一线生机。
霍斯曼认为这是比赛的关键时刻，再加上中场休息时路易斯·穆尼奥斯的登场，为我们奋起直追并扭转局势打下了基础。
“我们凭借一次精彩的头球打进了一粒关键进球，并在中场休息时回到更衣室。我认为路易斯的上场尤其对比赛产生了巨大影响。对于这么年轻的球员来说，队员们展现出的性格简直难以置信，因为记住，我们甚至比他们还要年轻得多。”
“但我们信任并相信他们，我认为他们展现出了性格和心态，在他们所处的这种环境下，我们最终配得上这场胜利。不过这项赛事中需要学习的东西还有很多。”
“这就是为什么理想情况下，我们希望给他们至少再踢一场比赛，或者尽可能多的比赛，因为这些比赛的水平比我们在国内踢的要高得多。我们要对阵的是一支每周都在一起踢球的U19球队，而我们只是在赛前几天才聚到一起。”
战胜多特蒙德让我们完全有机会争夺淘汰赛席位，排名前22位的球队将晋级32强。
霍斯曼认为，由于我们将在最后一场比赛中主场迎战卫冕冠军皇家马德里，形势将会非常艰难。不过，学院主教练从前五场比赛中看到了足够多的东西，坚信我们确实有机会从这场比赛中有所收获。
“如果他们想要职业生涯，无论是不是这样，媒体都会把这些大战炒作成巅峰对决。因此，为了尽我们所能为他们做好准备，我们必须让他们提前品尝一下他们希望每周都能经历的赛事。这很理想。”
“他们可能是欧洲最好的球队。他们去年赢得了冠军，在三十多支球队中高居联赛榜首，他们非常优秀。这种级别的比赛将会非常艰难，但我们也很不错。”
“我们能进球，到目前为止我们参加了每一场比赛；我认为我们需要一个积分，我们的净胜球还算可以，这给我们留下了一点机会。我们会去拼搏，因为从宏观来看更有意义。”
“但对于我们和那里的男孩们来说，我认为凭借我们经历过的这组赛程，我们没有踢过哪怕一场轻松的比赛，每场比赛都非常艰难。男孩们绝对为俱乐部争了光，所以我们带着希望进入最后一场比赛。我们会尽力而为，看看结果如何。”

items.summaryEn: We came from two goals down to earn all three points in north London on Tuesday afternoon
bodyEn: Our under-19s came from 2-0 down to beat 10-man Borussia Dortmund 3-2 at Mangata Developments Stadium on Tuesday afternoon.

Dortmund were reduced to ten men midway through the first half when goalkeeper Aaron Held wiped out Andre Harriman-Annous, but that didn't stop the away side taking a 2-0 lead through Justin Hoy and Tim Deneger.

But we got one back through Marli Salmon right on half-time and equalised six minutes into the second half thanks to Luis Munoz's stunning strike, before the young forward set up Josh Ogunnaike to net a late winner.
FAST START YIELDS DORTMUND RED

We dominated the early stages of the contest and came close to an early lead when a corner was cleared to Ogunnaike on the edge of the box, with the defender's looped effort cleared off the line by Liam Claude Kante.

Dortmund saw little of the ball in the opening 20 minutes, but almost caught us out on the counter when Enzo Dos Santos released Fadi Zarqelain with a defence splitting pass, forcing a sliding block from Elijah Upson to snuff out the danger.
Upson was on the scene in the opposite penalty area moments later, latching onto a teasing set-piece delivery at the far post, but placed his header wide.

A difficult start for the visitors was made all the more challenging after 24 minutes when Emerson Nwaneri released Harriman-Annous, who was wiped out by Dortmund goalkeeper Aaron Held, leaving the referee no choice but to dismiss the German shot-stopper.
DOMINANCE UNDONE BY ERRORS

We continued to control the tempo, but with their first attack after the red card, the German side took the lead when we failed to clear a low cross, affording Hoy a simple finish from eight yards out.

Our Gunners responded well to conceding the opening goal, stepping up the tempo in search of an equaliser. Maalik Hashi found himself in on goal after an intricate move in the penalty area, but the offside flag denied him a shot at goal.
But with the momentum firmly on our side, an errant pass from goalkeeper Charlie Phillips gifted possession to Deneger, who made no mistake with the goal at his mercy.
Dortmund's two-goal lead didn't last long though, as Salmon's perfectly-placed header from Hashi's corner got us back into the contest right on half-time.
MUNOZ STUNNER INSPRIRES COMEBACK

With restored belief after Salmon's strike, we created a flurry of chances at the start of the second half. Harriman-Annous and Nwaneri both had efforts blocked in the penalty area, with the former almost cutting out a Dortmund back pass from close range.
But we weren't made to wait long for our leveller, as half-time substitute Luis Munoz danced through three opponents before unleashing a rocket into the near top corner.

A well-worked move created an opening soon after the equaliser, with Mylo Bernard darting to the byline and picking out Harriman-Annous, but the striker's near-post flick landed just the wrong side of the post.

Bernard continued to find space on the wing, creating another chance on the counter-attack, this time looking for Nwaneri at the far post, only for Froese to come flying out of his goal to cut out the cross.

Another precise passing move created an opening midway through the half, this time with Nwaneri spinning his marker to find Hashi, but the midfielder placed his effort just over the crossbar from the edge of the penalty area.
But after a half full of chances, we finally completed the turnaround when Munoz teed up Ogunnaike to place a precise effort in the bottom corner from 20 yards, completing a memorable turnaround.

It should have been four in the closing moments of the game when Vincent Joseph stole possession in the final third, but although the striker fired his effort straight at Froese, we held out for three valuable points.
WHAT IT MEANS

Victory at Mangata Developments Stadium takes us into the top 22 with one league phase game remaining. We'll need at least a point from our final game against Real Madrid, while a win over the Spanish side will ensure our place in the Round of 32.
WHAT'S NEXT

Our under-19s split back into our under-21s and under-18s squads for league matches this weekend. Our under-18s take on Bournemouth at the Sobha Realty Training Centre on Saturday (12pm UK), before our under-21s head to Lancashire to face Blackburn Rovers on Monday night (7pm UK).
We'll be back in UEFA Youth League action on Wednesday, December 9 with a bumper tie at home to Real Madrid, in what will be the final game of our league phase campaign.
LINE-UPS
Arsenal XI: Phillips, Hamill (Munoz, 46'), Salmon, Upson, Ogunnaike, Ibrahim (Murisa, 68'), Julienne (Maghoma, 73'), Hashi, Bernard (Joseph, 76'), Harriman-Annous, Nwaneri
Subs: Talbot, Clarke, Abubakar, Mbala, Odaji-Ukueku
Dortmund XI: Held, Vogt (Ritter, 70') , Kante, Reggiani (Konig, 46'), Kaua Prates, Degener (Dzonga, 62'), Fahrenhorst, Dos Santos (Faust, 46'), Hoy, Garoarsson (Froese, 24'), Zarqelain

items.summaryZh: 阿森纳U19在两球落后的情况下连扳三球，以3-2逆转战胜10人多特蒙德。
bodyZh: 周二下午，我们的U19在曼加塔发展球场在0-2落后的绝境下奋起直追，最终以3-2逆转击败了只剩10人的多特蒙德。
比赛进行到上半场中段时，多特蒙德门将阿龙·黑尔德放倒了安德雷·哈里曼-阿努斯被红牌罚下，但这并未阻止客队通过贾斯廷·霍伊和蒂姆·德内格尔的进球取得2-0的领先。
不过我们在半场结束前由马利·萨尔门扳回一城，下半场开始六分钟后，路易斯·穆尼奥斯轰入一记世界波将比分扳平，随后这位年轻的前锋又助攻乔什·奥贡奈克打入了制胜球。
梦幻开局造就多特红牌
我们在比赛初期占据优势，并险些早早取得领先。一次角球开出后，皮球被解围到禁区边缘的奥贡奈克脚下，这名后卫的吊射被利亚姆·克劳德·坎特在门线前解围。
多特蒙德在开场前20分钟控球率不高，但差点通过反击制造威胁。恩佐·多斯桑托斯送出一记穿透防线的直塞找到法迪·扎尔凯兰，迫使埃利贾·厄普森及时滑铲封堵化解了危机。
不久后，厄普森又在对方禁区内觅得良机，他在远门柱接到了极具威胁的定位球传中，但头球顶偏。
比赛第24分钟，埃默森·恩瓦内里传球找到哈里曼-阿努斯，后者被多特蒙德门将阿龙·黑尔德放倒，主裁判毫不犹豫地向这名德国门将出示红牌将其罚下，让客队的艰难开局雪上加霜。
失误导致优势化为乌有
我们继续掌控着比赛节奏，然而在多特蒙德罚下一人后的第一次进攻中，我们就未能解围一记低平球传中，导致霍伊在8码处轻松推射破门，客队反而取得领先。
枪手小伙子们对失球做出积极回应，他们提升节奏寻找扳平机会。经过禁区内的一次精妙配合，马利克·哈希获得面对球门的机会，但边裁举旗示意越位，取消了他的射门。
然而在优势完全倒向我们这一侧时，门将查理·菲利普斯的一次传球失误却将球送到了德内格尔脚下，面对空门后者笑纳大礼。
不过多特蒙德两球领先的优势并未维持太久，就在半场结束前，哈希开出角球，萨尔门在门前精准头球破门，将我们的生还希望重新带回比赛。
穆尼奥斯世界波吹响反击号角
萨尔门的进球重塑了我们的信念，下半场刚开始我们便创造出一波又一波的进攻机会。哈里曼-阿努斯和恩瓦内里在禁区内的射门均被封堵，前者还差一点在近距离截断多特蒙德的回传。
但我们没有等待太久便扳平了比分。半场替补登场的路易斯·穆尼奥斯连续过掉三名防守球员，随后轰出一记直窜球门近端死角的火箭怒射。
扳平比分不久后，一次精妙配合再度制造杀机，迈洛·伯纳德带球杀向底线并传中找到哈里曼-阿努斯，但这位前锋近门柱的垫射稍稍偏出。
伯纳德继续在边路寻找空间，并在反击中创造出另一次机会。这一次他试图寻找远端包抄的恩瓦内里，但对方门将弗勒泽及时出击将传中球化解。
下半场中段，又一次精确的传切配合创造出良机。恩瓦内里转身晃过防守球员后分球给哈希，但这名中场在禁区边缘的射门稍稍高出横梁。
经历了一个机会不断的下半场后，我们终于完成了大翻盘：穆尼奥斯助攻奥贡奈克在20码处冷静推射底角得手，完成了一场令人难忘的逆转。
比赛临近结束时本应将比分改写为4-2，当时文森特·约瑟夫在前场完成抢断，虽然这名前锋的射门被弗勒泽直接没收，但我们依然将胜果保持到了最后，全取三分。
积分榜形势
在曼加塔发展球场取胜后，我们在联赛阶段还剩一场比赛的情况下升至积分榜前22名。我们在对阵皇家马德里的最后一场比赛中至少需要拿到一分，而如果击败这支西班牙球队，则将确保我们晋级32强。
赛程预告
本周末，我们的U19小将们将分流至U21和U18梯队参加联赛。周六（英国时间中午12点），U18将在索布哈地產训练中心对阵伯恩茅斯；周一晚（英国时间晚上7点），U21则将前往兰开夏郡挑战布莱克本流浪者。
12月9日周三，我们将重返欧洲青年联赛赛场，在主场迎来对阵皇家马德里的焦点大战，这也是我们联赛阶段的最后一场比赛。

items.titleEn: Odegaard on his recent form and reuniting with Nwaneri
items.summaryEn: In his captain's column, Martin Odegaard looks at recent games and reveals the advice he gave Ethan Nwaneri before his Dortmund move
bodyEn: Throughout the season, Martin Odegaard will open the door to life in our changing room via his captain's column in the official Arsenal matchday programme.
Before we face Borussia Dortmund ahead of the international break, Martin reflects on the Newcastle result, his form for club and country and a reunion with Ethan Nwaneri. Here is a snippet:

We started really well against Newcastle at the weekend, but we can't be happy with what we did in the second half. We were brilliant in the first half, but after that it was a combination of us not being at our level and Newcastle improving a lot as well.

There are small margins in every game, and the margin between scoring and not can be really small, but also make a big difference to the game. It can be a centimetre or two – the final pass, the final shot or whatever it is, and we need to be ruthless in those moments. It’s something we're going to keep working on and keep improving on, because we know if we keep playing like that, then we're going to win a lot of games. We just need to be on it for 90 minutes and not 70 minutes.

I was happy to get an assist for the second goal. After scoring the winner in the last game against Hull and scoring and assisting for my country in the international break, I’m happy with my form. But to be honest, I’m more thinking about my mistake for Newcastle’s first goal because that was really frustrating. It’s on me, it wasn’t a foul, it’s my mistake and I need to do better there.

Generally though I’m pleased with my form, and the goal in the last game here against Hull was really important in the end. That was a good win, a big win from another game where we had to dig deep, and work really hard to get over the line.

That was a good way to send us into the international break, and it was a really good one for Norway. We won both games and have reached the quarter-final of the Nations League, and coming on the back of the World Cup it’s a good time for us. We have a really good generation at the moment, there a lot of players of a similar age and we are finding our best form together. It’s coming together nicely, and the manager has really built something over time.

So next for us it’s England in the quarter-final, which is a big one especially because we were so frustrated with the game in the World Cup. That’s not for a few months though, so we’ll look forward to it then.

I’ll be seeing one of my Norway teammates tonight, as well as Julian Ryerson plays for Borussia Dortmund. I’ve watched a couple of their games this season, and they are obviously a really strong team. They always have big players and are always fighting at the top of the German League so we are expecting a tough game. They are top of the table at the moment, giving Bayern a good fight so it’s definitely another big night at Emirates Stadium.

It will also be good to see Ethan Nwaneri again tonight, who is on loan there at the moment. Before he went at the start of the season I spoke to him about some of my good experiences of going out on loan and how valuable it can be.

I’m sure he’s going to mature and learn a lot while he’s there, just like he did the last time he went out on loan. Being on loan is about working hard, giving everything for your new group and making the most of the experience. Learning from different teammates, a different culture and putting it all to good use when you come back to your club.
So we are looking forward to seeing him, but tonight is all about us performing well to carry on our momentum in the Champions League.

items.titleZh: 厄德高谈近期状态与重逢恩瓦内里
items.summaryZh: 厄德高在队长专栏中谈到近期比赛，并透露了恩瓦内里租借离队前给他的建议。
bodyZh: 整个赛季期间，马丁·厄德高将通过在官方阿森纳比赛日场刊中的队长专栏，向读者敞开心扉讲述更衣室里的生活。
在国际比赛日前迎战多特蒙德之前，马丁回顾了对阵纽卡斯尔的结果、他在俱乐部和国家队的状态，以及与恩瓦内里重逢的感受。以下是部分内容：
我们在周末对阵纽卡斯尔时开局踢得很好，但我们不能对下半场的表现感到满意。我们在上半场表现出色，但之后是我们自身未达到应有水准以及纽卡斯尔大幅提升的综合结果。
每场比赛的差距都在毫厘之间，进球与否的差距可能非常小，但对比赛结果有着重大影响。那可能是一两厘米的差距——最后一传、最后一射或其他什么，我们需要在那些时刻保持杀手本能。这是我们将继续努力和改进的方面，因为我们知道如果继续这样踢，我们会赢得很多比赛。我们只需要坚持90分钟而不是70分钟。
我很高兴能为第二个进球贡献助攻。继上一场对阵赫尔城的比赛中打入制胜球，以及在国际比赛日为国家队贡献传射后，我对自己的状态感到满意。但老实说，我更在意自己在纽卡斯尔第一个丢球时的失误，因为那真的令人沮丧。那是我的责任，那不是犯规，那是我的失误，我需要在那里做得更好。
不过总的来说我对自己的状态感到满意，上一场在这里对阵赫尔城的进球最终非常重要。那是一场不错的胜利，是一场我们需要全力以赴、艰苦奋斗才能过关的重大胜利。
那是让我们进入国际比赛日的好方式，对挪威队来说也是一个非常棒的时期。我们赢下了两场比赛并晋级了欧国联四分之一决赛，在世界杯之后，这对我们来说是个好时机。我们目前拥有非常优秀的一代球员，有很多年龄相仿的球员，我们正在一起寻找最佳状态。一切都在顺利融合，主教练多年来确实建立了一些成果。
所以我们接下来的对手是在四分之一决赛中对阵英格兰，这是一场重头戏，尤其是因为我们对世界杯上的那场比赛感到非常沮丧。不过那还要几个月后才会到来，所以我们到时候再期待吧。
我今晚会见到一位挪威队友，尤利安·莱尔森目前效力于多特蒙德。我本赛季看过他们的一些比赛，他们显然是一支非常强大的球队。他们总是拥有大牌球员，并且一直在德国联赛顶级行列中竞争，所以我们期待一场艰苦的比赛。他们目前处于积分榜榜首，给拜仁制造了强有力的竞争，所以这绝对是酋长球场又一个伟大的夜晚。
今晚再次见到目前被租借到那里的恩瓦内里也将是一件美好的事。在他赛季初离队之前，我和他谈过我当年外租的一些好经历以及这种经历有多么宝贵。
我确信他在那里会成熟并学到很多东西，就像他上一次被租借时一样。租借意味着努力工作，为你的新团队付出一切，并充分利用这段经历。向不同的队友学习，体验不同的文化，并在回到俱乐部时将其派上用场。
因此，我们期待见到他，但今晚的一切都关乎我们自身的表现，以延续我们在欧冠中的势头。

bodyEn: Ethan Nwaneri has one record Max Dowman can never break. It is more than four years since he became the youngest player to appear in the Premier League, with Dowman, his fellow Hale End academy graduate, older by 54 days when he made his highly anticipated debut. But after a week when Arsenal published an article dedicated to Dowman’s growing collection of milestones, Nwaneri risks becoming the club’s forgotten teenager.

Nwaneri joined Borussia Dortmund on loan in the summer and returns to the Emirates Stadium in the Champions League on Tuesday, although the 19-year-old will probably be on the bench, having not started for the German club yet in the competition. Despite making a good impression with an assist on his Bundesliga debut, against Hoffenheim, he has not started in the league since 17 October and has yet to complete more than 65 minutes in a Bundesliga match.

He was a stoppage-time substitute in Saturday’s win against Borussia Mönchengladbach, with Dortmund’s manager, Niko Kovac, saying Nwaneri faces a fight to get back in a team who lead Bayern Munich by two points and deploy the exciting Greece teenager Kosta Karetsas as one of two No 10s.

“We have some very good players in those attacking positions,” Kovac said before the Gladbach game. “The competition is fierce. He [Nwaneri] has played a lot of games and, at just 19 years of age, he will certainly play many more games for us.”

Nwaneri established that Premier League record in September 2022, at 15 years and 181 days old, but his real breakthrough came in the 2024-25 campaign as a replacement for the injured Bukayo Saka on the right. He scored eight goals, matching records set by Wayne Rooney and Michael Owen, and was even compared with Barcelona’s Lamine Yamal, who was also born in 2007.

Nwaneri was rewarded with a new long-term contract despite strong interest from Chelsea and Dortmund, who have a record of signing emerging English talent. Heavy investment by Arsenal that summer, including Eberechi Eze and Noni Madueke, meant he barely featured in the first half of last season and was allowed to join Marseille in January.

Arsenal chose the French club from a long list of suitors because they wanted him to develop under Roberto De Zerbi. Nwaneri scored on debut, but De Zerbi left by mutual consent a few weeks later and the attacking midfielder barely featured towards the end of the season.

The emergence of Dowman, who, as a 14-year-old, in December 2024, broke Nwaneri’s record as the youngest player to appear for Arsenal Under-21s, means he has slipped further down the pecking order. Mikel Arteta is understood to be keen for Nwaneri to develop as a No 10 rather than a winger and loaned him again despite not signing attacking reinforcements in the summer after the departures of Gabriel Martinelli and Gabriel Jesus. Arsenal’s manager said on Monday he had been disappointed by Nwaneri’s fortunes in Germany.

“Because you go there and because you come from Arsenal, it doesn’t give you any advantage, so you need to earn it,” he said. “You can have patches, but to find that consistency and to play a big amount of minutes and have a huge impact in such big football clubs like Arsenal or Dortmund, it’s extremely difficult. That’s the reality.
“You can just shine in moments, but moments are not enough. Now you need to show the consistency. Ethan has the capacity and the mentality to do that and it takes some time.”

While Nwaneri’s Arsenal career has stalled, he has seen his childhood friend Myles Lewis-Skelly begin to establish himself in his preferred central midfield role for club and country. The England Under-21s manager, Lee Carsley, remains a big fan, though, and Nwaneri repaid that faith by setting up the first two goals in a 3-2 win against France last week, even if Dowman took the headlines again by breaking Jude Bellingham’s record as their youngest goalscorer with a late winner.

Nwaneri, whose brother Emerson plays for Arsenal Under-18s, was one of four training players called up for England’s World Cup preparation camp in Florida, with Rio Ngumoha, Josh King and Alex Scott, and remains on Thomas Tuchel’s radar. But as Arteta, who was sent on loan from Barcelona to Paris Saint-Germain at the start of his career, acknowledged when asked whether Arsenal may consider a January recall that it is up to Nwaneri to rediscover his best form at Dortmund.

“He was in Marseille as well. Marseille had a completely different context for a lot of things that I saw and expected to happen. But that builds a player, that builds the character and the career of a player. I’m so convinced of that.”
For Arteta, there is only one meaningful way for Nwaneri to deal with the frustration of his role as a substitute. “Try to change it for the one that you want,” he said. “That’s football.”

items.titleZh: 恩瓦内里随多特蒙德重返阿森纳，面临逐渐被遗忘的风险
items.summaryZh: 恩瓦内里租借多特蒙德期间表现挣扎，重回酋长球场面临位置竞争。
bodyZh: 伊森·恩瓦内里（Ethan Nwaneri）拥有一项马克斯·多曼（Max Dowman）永远无法打破的纪录。自他成为英超历史上最年轻的出场球员以来，已经过去了四年多；而同为黑尔恩德青训产品的多曼在完成备受瞩目的首秀时，比他大了54天。然而，在阿森纳刚刚发表了一篇聚焦多曼不断创造里程碑的文章后，恩瓦内里却面临着成为俱乐部“被遗忘的少年”的风险。
恩瓦内里在今年夏天租借加盟多特蒙德，并将于周二随队在欧冠赛场重返酋长球场。尽管这位19岁的球员在这项赛事中尚未代表德国俱乐部首发，但周二他很可能会坐在替补席上。尽管在对阵霍芬海姆的德甲首秀中送出助攻给人留下了深刻印象，但他自10月17日以来就再未在联赛中首发，且在一场德甲比赛中的出场时间从未超过65分钟。
在上周六多特蒙德击败门兴格拉德巴赫的比赛中，他在补时阶段替补登场。多特蒙德主帅尼科·科瓦奇（Niko Kovac）表示，恩瓦内里面临着激烈的竞争，需要努力重回首发阵容。目前多特蒙德在积分榜上领先拜仁慕尼黑两分，并重用令人兴奋的希腊少年科斯塔·卡雷查斯（Kosta Karetsas）担任两名10号位球员之一。
科瓦奇在对阵门兴的比赛前表示：“我们在这些进攻位置上拥有非常优秀的球员。竞争非常激烈。他（恩瓦内里）已经踢了很多比赛，年仅19岁的他未来肯定会为我们踢更多比赛。”
恩瓦内里在2022年9月创造了英超出场纪录，当时他年仅15岁零181天，但他的真正爆发是在2024-25赛季，当时他作为受伤的布卡约·萨卡（Bukayo Saka）的右路替补。他攻入八球，追平了韦恩·鲁尼和迈克尔·欧文创造的纪录，甚至被拿来与同样出生于2007年的巴塞罗那球员拉明·亚马尔（Lamine Yamal）作比较。
尽管切尔西和多特蒙德（后者一向有签下英格兰新星的记录）表现出强烈兴趣，恩瓦内里还是凭借一份新的长期合同得到了回报。阿森纳那个夏天的重磅引援（包括埃贝雷奇·埃泽和诺尼·马杜埃凯）意味着他在上赛季上半程几乎没有获得出场机会，并被允许在1月租借加盟马赛。
阿森纳从众多追求者中选择了这家法国俱乐部，是因为他们希望他在罗伯托·德泽尔比（Roberto De Zerbi）手下成长。恩瓦内里在首秀中就取得了进球，但几周后德泽尔比双方协商离任，这位进攻型中场在赛季末段几乎没有获得出场机会。
多曼的崛起（2024年12月，年仅14岁的多曼打破了恩瓦内里保持的阿森纳U21最年轻出场球员纪录）意味着恩瓦内里在队内的顺位进一步下滑。据了解，米克尔·阿尔特塔（Mikel Arteta）希望恩瓦内里能作为10号位而不是边锋来发展，尽管在马丁内利和加布里埃尔·热苏斯离队后的夏天没有签下进攻端增援，他还是再次将其租借。阿森纳主帅周一表示，他对恩瓦内里在德国的遭遇感到失望。
他说：“因为你去了那里，因为你来自阿森纳，这并不意味着你能获得任何优势，所以你需要靠自己去赢得它。你可能会有一段高光期，但在像阿森纳或多特蒙德这样的大型足球俱乐部里，要保持稳定性、踢很长时间的比赛并产生巨大的影响极其困难。这就是现实。”
“你只能在某些时刻闪光，但仅仅有时刻是不够的。现在你需要展现出稳定性。伊森有这种能力和心态，但这需要一些时间。”

尽管恩瓦内里的阿森纳生涯陷入停滞，但他看到童年好友迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利（Myles Lewis-Skelly）开始在俱乐部和国家队自己偏爱的中场中路位置站稳脚跟。不过，英格兰U21主帅李·卡斯利（Lee Carsley）依然是他的狂热拥趸，恩瓦内里在上周对阵法国的比赛中助攻前两球，回报了这份信任，尽管多曼凭借一记晚场绝杀打破贝林厄姆的纪录成为最年轻进球者，再次抢占了头条。

恩瓦内里的弟弟埃默森（Emerson）效力于阿森纳U18梯队。他是被征召参加英格兰队在佛罗里达州世界杯备战训练营的四名年轻球员之一（其余三人为里奥·恩古莫哈、乔什·金和亚历克斯·斯科特），并且依然在托马斯·图赫尔（Thomas Tuchel）的考察范围之内。当被问及阿森纳是否会考虑在一月份将其召回时，阿尔特塔（他自己职业生涯之初曾被从巴塞罗那租借至巴黎圣日耳曼）承认，这取决于恩瓦内里能否在多特蒙德找回最佳状态。
“他之前也在马赛。马赛有很多情况与我所看到和预期的情况完全不同，那是一个完全不同的环境。但这能塑造一名球员，塑造球员的性格和职业生涯。对此我深信不疑。”
在阿尔特塔看来，恩瓦内里摆脱替补角色沮丧感的唯一有意义的方式只有一个。“努力去改变它，成为你想成为的那个人，”他说。“这就是足球。”

bodyEn: Mikel Arteta is hopeful the ­shoulder injury David Raya sustained at Newcastle is not too serious, but confirmed the goalkeeper would miss Tuesday’s Champions League game against Borussia Dortmund.

Raya was forced off in the ­second half of Saturday’s 2-2 draw with a ­suspected dislocated shoulder, ­raising fears he could be sidelined for an extended period. He had an MRI scan on Arsenal’s return to London and was absent from ­training on Monday. Kepa Arrizabalaga is expected to deputise at home to Dortmund.

“He’s not fit for tomorrow, ­unfortunately, but it doesn’t look too serious,” the manager said. “With the pain he was showing immediately after the action we were all quite ­worried, but he seems to be better than what we expected. There’s no need of surgery, which was the main fear.”

Asked whether Raya could play at home to Manchester City on ­Sunday, Arteta said: “Tomorrow we’ll have more tests and we will know. I think we’ve seen what David brings to the team. That’s why we are very ­protective with Kepa and [third-choice] Illan [Meslier]. Everybody needs to be ready because these things happen.”

Dortmund are a point behind Arsenal in the Champions League after three wins from their first four matches and Niko Kovac’s side lead Bayern Munich by two points at the top of the Bundesliga. Arteta said a youthful side expected to feature Jobe Bellingham – who was called up by England for the first time for the most recent international break alongside his brother, Jude – would provide a real test.

“You have to congratulate mum and dad for what they’ve done,” Arteta said of the Bellingham ­brothers. “Two amazing ­footballers, what they’re doing is ­remarkable. So let’s give credit as well to the parents.”

items.summaryEn: Keeper close to tears at Newcastle after hurting shoulderArsenal held 2-2, with Jaissle hailing ‘excellent’ displayArsenal were left sweating on the fitness of their goalkeeper David Raya after the Spaniard was forced off with a shoulder injury during the second half of the 2-2 draw at Newcastle on Saturday evening.It left Mikel Arteta’s side six points clear of Brighton and Manchester City at the top of the Premier League but Arsenal’s manager was more concerned about Raya following an accidental collision with Newcastle’s William Osula. The Spaniard was helped off in evident pain and looked close to tears. Continue reading...
bodyEn: Arsenal were left sweating on the fitness of their goalkeeper David Raya after the Spaniard was forced off with a shoulder injury during the second half of the 2-2 draw at Newcastle on Saturday evening.

It left Mikel Arteta’s side six points clear of Brighton and Manchester City at the top of the Premier League but Arsenal’s manager was more concerned about Raya following an accidental collision with Newcastle’s William Osula. The Spaniard was helped off in evident pain and looked close to tears.

“Obviously it’s not good David had to come off but at the moment I don’t know [the prognosis],” said Arteta, explaining that a keeper who kept seven clean sheets in the season’s opening 10 games will have the joint scanned on Sunday. “He will have an MRI tomorrow. We will have more information tomorrow. But we know how important David is to us.”

Arsenal were 1-0 up at half-time at St James’ Park thanks to a goal from Eberechi Eze during an opening 45 minutes dominated by the visitors. Newcastle, though, improved significantly after the break and took the lead thanks to goals from Harvey Barnes and Malick Thiaw before Noni Madueke equalised.

“My feeling is we have lost two points,” said Arteta. “We were exceptional in the first half but we needed to score three or four goals and we didn’t. We knew there’d be a response but the way we gave Newcastle’s first goal away was completely unacceptable. We came back and scored a second goal but we lacked the moment of magic to kill the game. I don’t think we switched off in the second half; sometimes you have to praise the opposition.”

Matthias Jaissle was left smiling after that second-half performance rescued a game watched by Newcastle’s chair, Yasir al-Rumayyan. He had flown in from Riyadh to witness his first match of the season and is believed to have complimented his head coach afterwards.

“What you saw in the second half was Newcastle’s DNA par excellence and that’s something we can build on,” said Jaissle. “But we’ve got to be humble and realistic. The first half was not good and the second half was excellent. I’ve got mixed feelings because a little more was possible but a point was probably fair.

“I was a bit frustrated at half-time but we encouraged the players to do the high press in the right way and adopt a front-foot approach. There was no hesitating, no doubting, just pure belief and we clicked. I knew we were able to do it, so I was really pleased. We felt unbelievable connections and synergy with the crowd.
“To get a team as good as Arsenal shaking in your stadium was unbelievable. I hope we can carry on this feeling.”

items.summaryZh: 阿森纳门将大卫·拉亚肩膀受伤，阿尔特塔表示将接受核磁共振检查。
bodyZh: 周六晚在纽卡斯尔2-2战平的比赛中，阿森纳门将大卫·拉亚在下半场因肩膀受伤被迫离场，俱乐部对他的身体状况感到担忧。
这使得米克尔·阿尔特塔的球队在英超积分榜上位居榜首，领先布莱顿和曼城六分，但由于拉亚与纽卡斯尔球员威廉·奥苏拉发生意外碰撞，阿森纳主帅对他的情况更加关切。这名西班牙门将在明显的痛苦中被搀扶离场，看起来快要哭了。
“显然大卫不得不离场并不是件好事，但目前我（还不知道伤情预测），”阿尔特塔解释说，这名在本赛季前10场比赛中完成7次零封的门将将在周日接受关节扫描。“他明天将进行核磁共振检查。我们明天会有更多信息。但我们知道大卫对我们有多重要。”
凭借埃贝雷奇·埃泽在上半场的进球，在由客队占优的前45分钟过后，阿森纳在圣詹姆斯公园球场以1-0领先。然而，纽卡斯尔在中场休息后表现显著提升，凭借哈维·巴恩斯和马利克·佳夫的进球取得领先，随后马杜埃凯扳平了比分。
